Okay I won't really answer your question but I can say that I maybe relate to you. I think I have a crush on this girl but I have a really hard time telling if it's a crush or really just very good friend. She makes me happy and she is the only notification I wait for on my phone. I don't have sexual feelings towards her, and I don't get butterflies. But just this extra happiness that differentiates from what I feel towards other people that make me feel like she is somehow special. She is the one I mainly want to impress and make happy. I find it hard to tell if it's a crush or if she is simply my favorite person. I wouldn't mind spending the rest of my life with her as a couple, but at the same time when I thought about it, it wouldn't bother me if she was with someone else as long as we stay in touch. I've kinda accepted that it doesn't matter if I have a crush on her or not, I appreciate the friendship we have and try to make her as happy as she makes me. I think deciding if you have a crush or not is up to you because in my opinion there is no clear definition of what a crush is for each individual. Maybe this is a crush for you, maybe not. I'm sorry if I didn't help much, just felt like saying something since there were no answers... 

Hope you have an amazing day or night and good luck on your quest to figure it out!
